people.name: Eglon
people.line: King of Moab who oppressed Israel

people.name: Moab

translations.web: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
translations.bsb: and brought the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was an obese man.
translations.kjv: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
translations.asv: And he offered the tribute unto Eglon king of Moab: now Eglon was a very fat man.
